content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the lack of serialization during indirect access to PHY registers in the Realtek rtl8365mb driver. Concurrent access to switch registers while an indirect PHY register read or write was ongoing could lead to corrupted data being read back, resulting in the PHY subsystem incorrectly interpreting the link status. This was due to the hardware design, where any register access other than the status register during an indirect read would abort the operation, leading to inconsistent and nonsensical data being returned.
